        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            # Split on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists and release info
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:

                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release': release.strip()})

                # maybe no release info? but all have RELEASED_AT
